papers.summary: Abstract The Cepu field continues to face recurring tubing failures in sucker-rod wells due to localized internal wear on reused tubing. Conventional inspection using Ultrasonic Testing (UT), performed at only 12 points per joint, fails to detect thinning that occurs between measurement locations. In 2024, tubing leaks accounted for 74% of total failure-related losses during well service activities, resulting in USD 420,930.40 in Loss Production Opportunity (LPO). papers.summary: This study examines the evolution of the Aegean Robotics Competition (ARC) from a face-to-face educational robotics event to an online competition format. papers.summary: Abstract Cryogenic NGL demethanizers suffer from energy inefficiencies due to non-convex thermodynamic constraints. papers.summary: Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) are widely applied in marine exploration and other missions due to their low cost and high reliability. Point-to-point path planning serves as the foundation for accomplishing various marine tasks. The limitations of sonar sensor detection pose significant challenges for UUV obstacle avoidance path planning in 3D dynamic environments. papers.summary: Abstract Computer vision technologies are increasingly used across Oil and Gas operations to support inspection, monitoring, and surveillance tasks. In industrial environments, however, image quality is often degraded by lens-induced optical distortions and environmental noise arising from low illumination, dust, vibration, and sensor limitations. papers.title: VitiBench Dataset Suite
papers.summary: The VitiBench Dataset Suite is a collection of datasets designed to support computer vision applications in viticulture. It comprises two real-world grapevine leaf image datasets and one synthetic vineyard segmentation dataset. The first leaf dataset contains 472 RGB images representing six Vitis vinifera L. cultivars acquired between May and July 2017 at the University of Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro experimental vineyards, Portugal, under controlled white-background conditions. papers.summary: Abstract Concrete cracking is one of the most prevalent indicators of structural deterioration, posing significant risks to the safety, serviceability, and longevity of civil infrastructure. Traditional manual visual inspections are labor-intensive, subjective, and prone to human error, making them inadequate for large-scale structural health monitoring (SHM). In recent years, computer vision and deep learning (DL) have emerged as transformative, automated alternatives. papers.summary: This dissertation examines the history of the auxiliaires de l'Apostolat, Catholic laywomen who are called by their bishop to support him in his apostolate through societal presence and spiritual exercise. Focusing on Belgium in its international context, the study explores how these women forged a form of life that did not fully align with traditional categories such as religious orders and congregations or secular institutes.
